## Summary

Describe the asset or catalog improvement and the FSI scenario it supports.

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `python scripts/validate_catalog.py`.
- [ ] The change is focused and does not duplicate an existing entry.
- [ ] Asset links, maintainers, maturity, and review date are accurate.
- [ ] The asset has documentation and an appropriate license.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, personal data, or confidential information
      are included.
- [ ] Relevant security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI considerations
      are documented.
